text:
maya: Heads-up 10y retention ask from GlacierCorp today. They want per-tenant CMKs, immutable export manifests, and legal-hold toggles. Need quick feasibility + high-level pricing to respond.

liam: 10y is huge but doable with cold-tiering + dedupe/compression. Estimate: ~80TB/yr raw -> ~18TB/yr after gzip+dedupe at their event rates. Still expect egress spikes for exports.

noor: Security constraints: per-tenant CMKs -> require a handshake + encrypted-wrapping keys in our HSM. Auditors will expect KMS attestation, rotation logs, and proof that deleted data is unrecoverable when TTL expires.

juris: Legal: for contract we need certified evidence format for exports (signed manifest + checksums + signer DID). Also need a legal-hold escape  flow so customers can pause deletion while we preserve chain-of-custody.

maya: Proposal sketch: retention tiers = default 90d, extended 3y, archival 10y. Features for archival tier: per-tenant CMK support (opt-in), immutable export package, legal-hold toggle (preserve manifests), retrieval SLOs (48h standard, 6h expedited), plus audit trail for key rotations. Pilot with GlacierCorp only.

liam: Rough engineering split:
- CMK handshake + key wrap flows: 3w
- immutable export packaging + signing pipeline: 2w
- lifecycle manager + cold job builder: 5w
- console UI & billing plumbing: 1.5w
Parallelize -> 8-9w minimum. QA + compliance review add 2-3w.

noor: Acceptance checklist (security): KMS attestation artifact, HSM-backed wrap, rotation audit logs, end-to-end test where exported package verifies against signer public key, and threat-model review for key import.

maya: Pricing notes: base retention SKU + per-GB/yr archival charge + retrieval fee (per-GB and per-export manifest). Put a cap on free emergency exports (e.g., 1TB/mo).

juris: Add contract clauses: retention SLA, export proof-of-evidence, export egress cap, indemnity carveouts for subpoena/third-party legal orders. Also define retention-change notice period.

devops-bot: @maya created task INF-8001: "archival-retention+cmk+export-packaging" assigned to infra backlog.

liam: retrieval plan: normal retrieval = background restore (48h), expedited uses warm-cache path (6h) and costs extra. Need runbook for legal-hold retrievals.

noor: SOC2/ISO acceptance: include rotation cadence (90d), attestation sample, and metadata retention schema that preserves chain-of-custody for every object.

maya: Action items: liam -> detailed infra estimate + cost per GB by Fri; noor -> security acceptance checklist + sample attestation text by Thu; juris -> draft contract clauses + export proof language by Fri; I'll draft pilot runbook + pricing sketch. Flag if timeline unrealistic. :raised_hands:
